# THE THREE PROPERTIES THE ACT SPECIFICALLY DEMANDS
both the integer and the float path, and was never confused with a
failure. The failure signal is a NULL POINTER, never a numeric
status, so the two can never collide.
BORROWED_LIFETIME_OBSERVED=YES -- the same static literal is returned
on repeated calls, its content is stable, it is NUL-terminated, and
the host neither freed nor wrote through it.
# 3. THE CSET ADAPTER PRESERVATION, WITH ITS ANTI-CONTROL
ADAPTER_OBSERVATION=YES -- a REAL compiled PolyC FOR result fed the
UNCHANGED host cset formatting and produced the exact bytes
ADAPTER_ANTI_CONTROL=YES -- formatting the same suffix entirely in the
host, with no PolyC involvement, produced a BYTE-IDENTICAL result.
This proves the adapter contributes NO independent decision: the
suffix is the only thing PolyC decided, and the rest is the host's
PolyC decision in the cset path (FOR), plus one C-side formatting
step. The adapter is not a second PolyC choice.
